name: UEA Championship
epitaph: The alliance-wide singles title the United E-Wrestling Alliance's own member federations built its one surviving super-card around, settled in a six-match-deep single-elimination bracket drawing entrants from LAW, UCW and the by-then-closed ILOC.
notes: Crowned in the singles half of the alliance's own joint singles-and-tag-team tournament, staged 24 Aug 1996 across a six-part card (uea-uea-tournament-part-1-of-6 through -6-of-6).

name: UEA Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The alliance-wide tag-team title crowned in the tag half of the United E-Wrestling Alliance's own joint tournament, settled in a three-round eight-team bracket drawing entrants from LAW and UCW.
notes: Crowned in the tag-team half of the same 24 Aug 1996 six-part super-card that crowned the UEA Championship (uea-uea-tournament-part-1-of-6 through -6-of-6). Both titles came out of the tournament's own opening division listing (part 1 of 6): eight teams, three rounds.
